capabilities: capture notes via an embedded native Obsidian editor with Ctrl+Enter submit and draft auto-save
store notes as plain Markdown in daily (YYYY-MM-DD.md) or yearly (YYYY.md) files, with a migration command
browse notes in a sticky-note waterfall card layout with hover link previews
search and filter notes by tags and keywords with quick filter tabs
view stats, heatmap, calendar, tag cloud, and a year panorama
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Documentation is bilingual (English and Simplified Chinese); installation is via Releases or the BRAT plugin.
intentEvidence: This project is a fork of i-iooi-i/obsidian-memoria.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in quick-capture timeline for jotting short thoughts as they come, with a card-flow view over them.

relations.evidence: This project is a fork of i-iooi-i/obsidian-memoria.

summary: Flow-style quick-capture plugin that records short notes through the native editor into daily or yearly Markdown files, shown in a waterfall card layout.
